about: The approved state of apps/backtest-worker for scripts/screener/check_backtest_untouched.mjs: the tripwire passes a worker that differs from origin/main only while its content hash is worker_tree and the versions are these. Recorded with --record and changed only by a deliberate commit (EXEC-MU-RUNTIME).

exec.decision: User 2026-11-16 (ERRORS M463, verbatim in EXEC-BACKTEST-REVAMP "Pelaksanaan deploy"): "tidak apa-apa untuk naikkan ke 2 GB apabila run memang diperlukan. Tapi bisa nggak setelah selesai run langsung dibuat tidur atau otomatis di-cut? ... RAM hanya berjalan ketika ada request saja", then "Go untuk opsi 1"

note: M463: a compute thread ends once it has no task left (compute.ts retire), a V8 heap limit per thread derived from the container memory (config.ts threadHeapMb, BACKTEST_THREAD_HEAP_MB), thread_start and thread_end log rss_bytes; the image sets MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 and MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_; three server tests; README memory section
